Hi Tom / Sylvia — Marissa here (Solutions Engineering). Thanks Irene. A few quick asks so we can prepare targeted content: 

- Which environment do you want us to discuss: staging (sandbox) or production topology? If staging, will we have test credentials or do you prefer an architecture-only walk?
